Hi Emily / Rajesh —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Clarified scope: ClearWave will want Redwood to be treated as a vendor with both PHI handling for a subset of integrations (HIPAA) and broader EU user data (GDPR). You indicated SOC 2 Type II is required for 2028 procurement, and ISO 27001 is desired for longer-term strategic alignment.
- Immediate asks from ClearWave: initial vendor security questionnaire and SOC 2 attestation status + expected timeline.
- Redwood action items: share a short SOC 2 readiness summary, the vendor questionnaire document for your team to complete, and propose a compliance roadmap with milestones for SOC 2 scope expansion and ISO/FedRAMP evaluation.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-readiness-summary.pdf (short status + timeline), ClearWave_SecurityQuestionnaire_v1.docx (blank version for you to fill).

Proposed next steps:
1) Emily / Rajesh: confirm who from ClearWave will be the primary intake contact for security (name + email) and whether you want the questionnaire split between IT and Product.
2) Book a 60-minute compliance intake call (we can run through questionnaire and key evidence paths). I suggest Wed 4/13 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 4/14 09:00–10:00 PT.
3) Internal: Marissa will run the intake and create the mutual action plan; Neha will scope the SOC 2 control families and flag any major gaps for PHI handling.

If that all looks good, Emily, please reply with the intake contact and preferred slot and attach a completed (even partial) questionnaire if you have one.

Thanks —

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0182

Emily / Rajesh —

Nice to meet you (virtually) on the call. A few follow-ups and an initial scoping view from our security team: 

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type I in 2026 and is targeting Type II by Q3 2027. That means most control evidence is in place, but Type II reporting window / monitoring needs to complete. I'll include the short "SOC 2 readiness summary" that Dylan attached in the intake notes.

2) HIPAA/PHI considerations: for any connectors where ClearWave will transmit PHI into Redwood-managed services, we recommend:
   - Execute BAA upfront
   - Configure customer KMS where possible (we support customer-managed keys via our Private deployment options)
   - Define retention and deletion SLA in the mutual action plan

3) ISO 27001 & FedRAMP path: ISO evaluation can start in parallel to SOC 2 Type II planning — it typically requires 6–9 months for gap remediation + audit scheduling. FedRAMP is a larger lift (cloud environment controls + JAB/agency sponsor); we can outline a FedRAMP readiness assessment but treat it as a longer-term program.

4) Evidence collection: we'll use the Drive folder Marissa shared. I've also attached a short internal checklist (security-eval-checklist.xlsx) showing documents we typically provide: network diagrams, encryption config, incident response runbook, BAA template, and sampled audit logs.

Next actions (owner / ETA):
- Redwood to send BAA + standard PHI clauses (Dylan) — by EOD 4/14.
- ClearWave to upload any pre-filled questionnaire pages to Drive — by 4/16.
- Redwood to produce a mutual action plan draft for SOC 2 Type II with milestone dates — initial draft by 4/20 (Marissa / Neha).

If there are any compliance nuances (state-level data residency, specific EU contractual clauses), please flag them and we'll incorporate into the roadmap.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
